before.lib/app.ex:
defmodule App do
  def add_charge(pid, amount) do
    :ok = Ledger.record(pid, amount)
    Ledger.total(pid)
  end
end
before.test/ledger_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule LedgerTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "records charges in the total" do
    {:ok, pid} = Ledger.start_link()
    assert App.add_charge(pid, 3) == 3
    assert App.add_charge(pid, 4) == 7
  end
end

after.lib/app.ex:
defmodule App do

end

after.test/state_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule StateTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "ledger tracks each new entry" do
    {:ok, pid} = Ledger.start_link()
    Ledger.record(pid, 3)
    assert Ledger.__test_state__(pid) == %{entries: [3]}
  end
end
